chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Thal'abah ibn Maymun, from Hammad ibn Bashir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted, says: 'Whoever humiliates a friend of Mine, he has prepared himself for war against Me.'

key_terms.وَلِيّاً: a friend or saint of God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He has declared war on someone?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith qudsi underscores the high status of the Awliya' in Shia theology, linking their honor directly to the Divine's readiness for war against their detractors. It serves as a foundational proof for the concept of 'Izzah' (honor) of the Imams and the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that disrespecting them is tantamount to declaring war on Allah Himself. This principle reinforces the spiritual and political authority of the Imams as the true friends of God.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Hammad Bin Bashir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Says: “The one who despises (hates) a friend of Mine<sup>azwj</sup>, so he has declared a war against Me<sup>azwj</sup>”’.
en.sarwar: 3. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from ibn Faddal from Tha’labah ibn Maymun from Hammad ibn Bashir from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
‘‘The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Allah, the Most Blessed, the Most High, has said, ‘‘Whoever insults any of My friends has waged a war against Me.’”
